_comment: Spike areas, EPSG:4326 [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat]. routing = bbox of the OSM city boundary (AGS 08416041, Geofabrik 2026-11-20) + 4 km; the pipeline uses the buffered polygon instead (arch. §5.2). test_clip = central Tübingen with Tal, Morgenstelle, Sand, Hbf, Waldhäuser-Ost; it stands in for config/test_clip.yaml, which S0.4 adds.
